''See also: [[Eliadel Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Eliadel, also known as [[Alin]], is the [[Incarnation of Elysia]], a city described as the tenth territory and a paradise of light. Known by the title "The Rising Sun," he is a figure of significant prophecy, foretold to be a [[Traveler of Elysia]] who would return to lead the free city of [[Enosh]] in a conflict against the [[King of Damasca]]. His actions are central to major historical shifts, including confronting King Zakareth VI{{!}}King Zakareth, ending sacrifices by addressing the Hanging Tree{{!}}Hanging Trees, and facilitating the reopening of the [[Gate of Heaven]] as the prison for the [[Incarnations]] begins to fail. While some view him as a good person, others identify him as the son of [[Torin]]. Throughout his journey, he is supported by figures such as [[Grandmaster Naraka]] and has been involved in the defense and leadership of various territories.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Eliadel possesses silver eyes and distinct chain marks on his arms. These markings are capable of changing from black to a bright, flaring white.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|At his core, Eliadel is considered a good man. He maintains a sense of trust toward [[Simon]].}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“We once only had the Nine Territories, Eliadel,” Naraka went on.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“I would say that Eliadel has fulfilled his role in prophecy,” Lirial said carefully. “He has, at last, confronted King Zakareth, the Evening Star.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|“Eliadel is a good man at heart,” a man’s voice said loudly.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c10" />}}
